Strike · Romania

KHORYV reports drone strike off Constanța; one dead and three missing

23 October 2026 · KHORYV off Constanța · Reported drone strike, fire and sinking

Reported drone strike and sinking in progress; one dead, nine rescued, three missing

The Comoros-flagged KHORYV reportedly came under drone attack off Constanța on 23 October 2026. Adevărul describes fire and sinking in progress, citing a drone-attack distress call. The operator is unknown.

The Naval Authority, quoted in the report, gave one dead, nine rescued and three missing. The location was outside Romanian territorial waters. The strike, fire, sinking report and rescue remain one record; a completed sinking has not been established.

Reported date
2026-10-23 (MRCC alerted around 10:00 local time)
Record type
reported_offshore_drone_strike
Date basis
The 10:00 time is the reported rescue alert, not an established strike time.
Location / jurisdiction
Black Sea, approximately 13 nautical miles off Constanța; outside Romanian territorial waters according to the Naval Authority quoted by Adevărul.
Event categories
Reported drone strike on merchant shipping; fire; reported sinking; search and rescue
What was reported
Adevărul reports a drone-attack distress call, fire and sinking in progress. These are retained as one incident.
Aircraft / vessel / quantity
KHORYV, Comoros-flagged OBO carrier. Drone type and number unknown.
Origin / operator / attribution
Operator and national origin unknown; no Russian or Ukrainian attribution established in the reviewed report.
Damage / casualties / disruption
Naval Authority figures quoted at 11:52: one dead, nine rescued alive and three missing, from thirteen crew (ten Ukrainians, three Azerbaijanis). Individual casualty nationalities unspecified. Completed sinking unconfirmed.
Response / outcome
MRCC coordinated ARSVOM and Interior Ministry rescue vessels. Poor weather and visibility prevented helicopter assistance; searches continued.
Investigation / uncertainty
Breaking-news snapshot. Drone causation is supported by the reported distress call, without a retrieved technical finding. Final vessel condition, missing crew’s fate and operator remain unresolved.
Route / entry mechanism
Reported voyage: Ereğli, Turkey, departed 21 October, toward Sulina. Drone approach unknown. Offshore attack, not a confirmed sovereign-territory incursion.
Explosive payload
Unknown. Fire does not establish a separate explosion.
Counting / links
One new KHORYV occurrence, distinct from WINE TRADER, YARA J, Sea Destiny and the earlier offshore attacks. Strike, fire, sinking report and rescue are not separate rows.
